title: Inlet Beach Retreat 202 | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Steps to the Beach – just a short stroll to the sugar-white sands and emerald waters* Private Pool and Hot Tub – your own secluded oasis for relaxing days* Stunning Gulf Views; Outdoor Patio with Grill – perfect for sunset dinners* 4 Bike
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Steps to the Beach – just a short stroll to the sugar-white sands and emerald waters* Private Pool and Hot Tub – your own secluded oasis for relaxing days* Stunning Gulf Views; Outdoor Patio with Grill – perfect for sunset dinners* 4 Bikes Included – explore scenic 30A with ease* 1 mile to Rosemary Beach; Less than a mile to Camp Helen State ParkSnorkel the Grouper Reef – a must-do adventure just offshore (see Area Attractions below)* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.*Fits 2 cars in the driveway.We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter RatesSnowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Inlet Beach Retreat — your coastal getaway just 100 yards from the beach and minutes from Rosemary Beach. This spacious 5-bedroom, 5-bath home sleeps up to 12 and features Gulf views, multiple balconies, and inviting spaces designed for both relaxation and gathering.The first floor offers a private guest suite with a Murphy bed, kitchenette, sleeper sofa, and direct access to the lanai with a private pool and spa, plus a ping pong game room for added fun. Upstairs, you’ll find two king master suites with en-suite baths and private porches with Gulf views, along with a bunk room for flexible sleeping. The top floor is built for entertaining with an open-concept living area, large balcony, and a gourmet kitchen with Wolf and Subzero appliances, plus an additional king suite with a private balcony. Enjoy your private pool, spa, and outdoor grilling area after a day at the beach. Located in peaceful Inlet Beach, you’re still just minutes from Rosemary Beach, 30Avenue, and local favorites like The Donut Hole and Shades—perfect for dining, exploring, or simply unwinding.The Bed Setup:1st FloorGuest Bedroom 1: Full Murphy Bed and Queen Sofa Bed2nd FloorMaster Bedroom 1: King BedMaster Bedroom 2: King BedGuest Bedroom 3: Twin over Twin Bunk Bed3rd FloorGuest Bedroom: King BedArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is just minutes away, offering shops, dining, and a charming town center with weekend markets.Enjoy the famous white sand beaches of 30A and explore nearby communities like Seacrest and Alys Beach. 30Avenue, just across Hwy 98, offers even more dining and shopping options.Don’t miss Grouper Reef, an artificial reef just 970 feet offshore, perfect for snorkeling and spotting marine life.
